title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-06
source: Unknown analog recording > PCM Sony L-750ESX-HFB Dynamicron EXCELLENT SUPER HIFI VIDEO CASSETTE->Sony SLO-1800 STEREO VIDEOCASSETTE RECORDER-> Sony PCM-601ESD DIGITAL AUDIO PROCESSOR-> SP/DIF-> Mytek Stereo 192 Sample Rate Converter-> Upsampled to 44.1kHz/24bit-> SP/DIF->RME FIREFACE 800-> FireWire 400-> Lenovo K450e Desktop PC-> WaveLab 6.11; tracked with Audacity-> flac level 8 and checksums with TLH-> tagged with Mp3tag; Editing and Mastering by Jamie Waddell in Wavelab 7.1; 16bit 44.1kHz Track, FLAC and Pack by John Wenzel

ai_review.summary: Excellent FM broadcast capture of a stellar show highlighted by an iconic The Other One → Cryptical Envelopment → Death Don't Hurt Me sequence, with crisp sound and lively crowd ambience.
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from the original KPFA/KPFB FM broadcast, delivers crystal‑clear audio while preserving the vibrant audience bleed that adds atmosphere. Musically the night is unforgettable – Jerry’s inspired lead shines throughout the blazing Other One → Cryptical → Death Don't sequence, and the rhythm section of Mickey and Bill is tight and on fire, with only a minor misfire in the first Lovelight solo.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review praises both the performance and the broadcast quality; minor solo slip is noted but does not detract from overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Broadcast‑level soundboard mix with great crowd ambience, clear instrument separation and no reported glitches.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, cohesive flow highlighted by an inspired mid‑set sequence; rhythm section locked in, with only a brief solo stumble early on.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Exceptionally inspired guitar work throughout, delivering the goods continuously; minor misfire in Lovelight solo.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey and Bill perfectly synchronized and on fire.
